name: Agent S
summary: Simular computer-use agent framework that uses screenshots and GUI actions to complete tasks in desktop and browser apps on macOS, Windows and Linux.
description: Apache-2.0 source and gui-agents Python package (0.3.2 on PyPI). The repository distinguishes Agent S3, the agent packaged in gui-agents, from Agent S4, which evolves tool interfaces from task experience and has separate setup instructions. Run locally using the version-specific README; model access and desktop permissions are required separately. Simular API and Sai are distinct hosted offerings, not a free hosted endpoint supplied by this package.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
